description: Every item id of a clue scroll, by tier, as NPC loot reports it (ClueScrollIds): each clue step is its own item. Generated from the gameval ItemID constants whose item name is exactly "Clue scroll (beginner)", "Clue scroll (easy)" and so on (RuneLite API 1.13.4, unchanged in 1.13.6). Caskets, keys, challenge scrolls, puzzle boxes, torn master clue parts and the Leagues-only scroll boxes are not clue scroll drops, so they are not included. Ids are RuneLite 1.13.6 gameval constants (net.runelite.api.gameval); "constant" names the constant each id was taken from.
